corrections.reason: The preposition ከ before ዕሩቅ ('ከዕሩቅ ብእሲ') is clearly printed on the page and required by the parallel Amharic construction ('ከእግዚአብሔር ... እንደናንተ ካለ ከዕሩቅ ብእሲ').

corrections.old_text: ፲፬ ፲፫ ማር ፮ ፴ ሉቃ ፱ ዘ ፲
corrections.corrected_text: ፲፬ ፲፫ ማር ፮ ፴ ሉቃ ፱ ፡ ፲
corrections.reason: In the marginal Gospel cross-reference 'ሉቃ ፱ ፡ ፲' (Luke 9:10), the word-separator colon (፡) between chapter 9 and verse 10 has vertical ink bleed that was misread as ዘ.
Joined with ከ- at the end of line 24, the word is ከዚህ ('ከዚህ በኋላ'); the 6th-order ህ was misread as 1st-order ሀ.
The verb is ሄደ (5th-order ሄ, matching line 26 right above it), where the right-leg ring of ሄ was misread as ሂ.
